meta.ai_note: both sides use the shipped combat.ai_take_turn (first affordable non-GUARD move in slot order, HEAD first); this understates optimized human play on both sides equally
meta.aims_core_note: part A uses entry.elite as aims_core (run-context rule); regulars never aim the core
meta.combat_note: combat.gd is fully deterministic; all variance comes from seeded build generation
meta.policy_note: venture policy: repair fully at every rest, loot highest-melt bit, forfeit lowest-melt broken bit, never extract (extraction reported as trigger + death-ahead rates)
meta.purse_note: own-build ventures pay NO win purse in shipped code (PlayerState.KIT_PURSE is kit-only); net scrap = forfeit salvage - repairs, loot melt value reported separately
